# Bundled TOML parser

smol-toml 1.3.1, BSD-3-Clause, by Cynthia. See LICENSE.
Source: https://github.com/squirrelchat/smol-toml
Distribution: https://registry.npmjs.org/smol-toml/-/smol-toml-1.3.1.tgz
Upstream tarball SHA-1: d9084a9e212142e3cab27ef4e2b8e8ba620bfe15

index.cjs is the unmodified upstream dist/index.cjs. It is self-contained and
requires no installation or network access at runtime. Used only for parsing
Codex config.toml; HTTP and filesystem operations use Node.js built-ins.
